court: In the High Court of Madras†
advocates: For Petitioner: Mr. E. Marees Kumar (in all W.Ps')
For Respondents: Mr. S. Angappan, (in all W.Ps') Government Advocate.
judgment_text:
Common Prayer: Writ Petitions filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying for the issuance of a writ of Mandamus, to direct the respondents to issue transport slips/permits to the petitioner under Rule 36 of the Tamil Nadu Minor Mineral Concession Rules, 1959 to enable the petitioners to transport the quarried mineral from the petitioners quarry in S.F. No. 490/2B(P), Mecode Village, Kalkulam Taluk, Kanyakumari District; S.F. Nos. 861/7P and 861/20P, Mecode Village, Kalkulam Taluk, Kanyakumari District and S.F. No. 10/4A(P) in Aloor Village, Kalkulam Taluk, Kanyakumari District to an extent of 1.00.0 hectares respectively within the time stipulated by this Court.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Anita Sumanth, J.:— Learned counsel for the petitioners seeks permission of this Court to withdraw the Writ Petitions and has also made an endorsement in this regard.

2. In the light of the same, these Writ Petitions stand dismissed as withdrawn. No costs. Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petitions are closed.
